data.one_liner: Send wake-on-LAN magic packets to devices on a local network.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to construct IP and MAC address instances, optionally include a SecureON password, and send Wake-on-LAN magic packets over UDP to wake local network devices.
use_when: You need to wake up local computers or devices from your Dart/Flutter application using Wake-on-LAN.
You are targeting Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, or Linux platforms.
avoid_when: You are targeting web browsers, since UDP sockets are not available in browsers due to security constraints.
You need delivery confirmation, as UDP sockets cannot confirm if the machine has been successfully awoken.
strengths: Supports both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
Supports SecureON password authentication and optional repeated packet sending.
weaknesses: Does not support web platforms because of browser security constraints regarding UDP.
Cannot confirm if the target machine has actually been awoken due to the nature of UDP.
